name: Acid Splash

targets.description: Each creature in a 5-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within range.

summary: Acid bursts in a 5-foot-radius Sphere; each creature there fails a Dex save to take 1d6 Acid damage.
text: Pick a point within range; a bubble of acid bursts there, filling a 5-foot-radius Sphere. Every creature in the Sphere makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 1d6 Acid damage on a failure and no damage on a success. The damage becomes 2d6 at character level 5, 3d6 at level 11 and 4d6 at level 17.
